**What changed**

A correction, an addition, or both.

**How you verified it**

The one field that matters. This directory is only worth more than a search engine because the entries were opened rather than copied, so say what you actually saw and roughly when.

If you are reporting something as dead, please confirm you ruled out the three false positives:

- [ ] Opened in a real browser, not just a script. A **403 is usually bot protection**.
- [ ] Not just a **`www` versus bare domain** redirect.
- [ ] Not judged on a **failed HEAD request**. Some hosts answer HEAD with 500 or 400 and serve GET fine.
- [ ] Country I checked from: <!-- reachability depends on where you ask -->

**House style**

- [ ] Plain sentences, no marketing copy
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes
- [ ] No affiliate links, referral codes or tracking parameters
- [ ] Any number I cite came from a page I actually fetched
